page: Microsoft Azure NV36adms_A10_v5 is a virtualized server instance belonging to the NVADSA10v5 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. This instance features 36 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD x86_64 processor. It is equipped with 880.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 24.44 GB per vCPU.

The hardware configuration includes a single NVIDIA A10 graphics processing unit with 22 GB of dedicated VRAM. For local storage, the instance is provisioned with 2949 GB of local SSD capacity and supports Premium Storage configurations.

Given the high density of system memory relative to the dedicated vCPUs, alongside a single enterprise GPU and substantial local SSD storage, this instance represents a specialized hardware profile. It is designed for memory-intensive workloads that require GPU acceleration, such as large-scale visualization, database hosting, and memory-heavy data processing pipelines.
